name: Kokan Hunter ~Amai Fukurami~
original_name: 股間ハンター ～甘いふくらみ～
source:
Goro Goro is the only groin hunter in the world. Today he will wander around the city again in search for shiny legs!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/02/vn-of-month-february-2001-tasogare.html]vndbreview[/url]]
